prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up, documentary press photograph on 35mm film with visible grain. A plain middle-aged white man with thinning grey-brown hair, tired eyes and a navy suit with a loosened blue tie stands knee-deep in scattered banknotes on a damp lawn, looking straight into the lens with a flat, expressionless, deadpan stare. Overcast flat daylight, slightly harsh on-camera flash. Behind him, softly out of focus, two bare trees, each with a blank wooden plaque hanging from a branch, no writing at all. A few notes still flutter in the air. Muted, slightly desaturated colour, ordinary and unglamorous, no logos, no text. Thanks.
